# Traitors
[color=#999999][italic]...is a standard, balanced cast of crew and traitors[/italic][/color]
Antagonists: [color=#ff0000]Traitors[/color]
Key Identities: None
## Summary
The most standard masquerade, both common in play and as a baseline of expectations for the other masquerades. Consider the following advice as shared between most Traitor-centered Masquerades.
Remember some identities might be (inadvertently) covering for the Traitors. Vandals especially can make it a lot hard to track the Traitor's progress towards their goal. Meanwhile, the Traitors will be using any leway they get and their comms to figure out a plan and execute it in the background.
Expect a generally even spread of traitor types, with guaranteed spawns of an Assassin and Infiltrator between random ones.
